nodes.label: SVG favicon mark: an abstract angular purple/violet geometric shape (a stylized parallelogram/ribbon form) built from overlapping blurred ellipse layers in shades of violet and light blue, on a transparent background. Notably this is a purple/violet abstract mark, not the navy/teal line-graph mark used by the other favicon and touch-icon assets in this project, suggesting it may be a leftover or alternate-brand asset rather than the current finlabs mark.
